nodes.label: Olympic Warriors logo (OW monogram badge)
nodes.description: 162x154 SVG badge: a black circle offset over a pale-yellow (#F9F3C1) circle to create a drop-shadow effect, with stylized angular 'OW' letterforms in the same pale yellow inside.
nodes.rationale: Two-tone pale yellow (#F9F3C1) on black defines the brand palette; the offset-circle shadow gives depth without gradients.

hyperedges.label: Olympic Warriors brand identity (logo + wordmark, #F9F3C1 on black)
